goal: Rewrite yacht and hospitality page metadata to lift organic click-through rate.
summary: The Spanish yacht and hospitality route now uses an exact-intent title and a clearer description grounded in the existing page content.
risk: Metadata-only adjustment on an existing indexed route; the URL, visible page content, and inventory remain unchanged.
public_claims: The revised copy stays within the established editing and selectively scoped local production positioning.
